recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: Manila Esposito Takes Balance Beam Bronze for Italy! 🤸‍♀️🇮🇹 | Paris 2024
recentItems.description:
📺 Re-live #Paris2024! ➡️ https://oly.ch/3REmN8s

Manila Esposito took bronze in the balance beam and silver in the women's team at Paris 2024. She went on to win three European gymnastics medals in 2026, including the floor exercise gold in Zagreb after dealing with online comments regarding her physique.

recentItems.description:

France's ice dancers Laurence Fournier Beaudry & Guillaume Cizeron danced their hearts out in their free dance to The Whale (SoundTrack) at Milano Cortina 2026, earning them gold in their debut season together. 

Relive the best moments from the Milano Cortina 2026 Winter Olympic Games, featuring elite athletes, thrilling competition, and unforgettable highlights across the world’s top winter sports on the Olympic stage.

recentItems.description:

The Republic of Korea won the gold medal with a victory over France in the men's team competition in archery at Paris 2024. France took silver and Turkiye claimed the bronze.
